description: This file defines React components for a toggle group UI, including ToggleGroup, Toggle, and ToggleGroupSeparator, with context management and styling.

methods.name: ToggleGroup
methods.description: React component for grouping toggle buttons with customizable orientation, variant, and size.

methods.name: Toggle
methods.description: React component representing an individual toggle button, inheriting context-based variant and size.

methods.name: ToggleGroupSeparator
methods.description: Component rendering a separator between toggle items with orientation support.
